channel.title: The Line Of Best Fit - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Line Of Best Fit (thelineofbestfit.com)

item.title: Blood Wizard to return with new EP, Lucky Life
item.description: South London-based project Blood Wizard, led by singer-songwriter Cai Burns, have announced their upcoming EP Lucky Life, and shared new single, "Daydreaming".

item.title: Savages celebrate ten years of Adore Life with unreleased songs, including Black Sabbath cover
item.description: To celebrate the 10-year anniversary of their second album, Adore Life, Savages have shared previously unreleased single "Prayer", and a cover of Black Sabbath's "Paranoid".

item.title: Drag, comedy, and film programming revealed for 2026 edition of Treefort Music Fest
item.description: Returning to Boise, Idaho for its fourteenth edition, Treefort Music Festival has unveiled their multidisciplinary program of art, comedy, drag, film, technology, and more, to take place between 25-29 March.

item.title: Robyn, Fcukers, Shania Twain among supports for Harry Styles Together, Together tour
item.description: Harry Styles has announced his Together, Together tour, a global residency taking place across seven cities, with £1 from every ticket sold to be donated to LIVE TRUST in support of expanding and protecting the grassroots music sector in the UK.

item.title: Denzel Curry unveils Southern hip-hop collective The Scythe and album Strictly 4 The Scythe
item.description: Denzel Curry has announced the formation of a new musical collective, The Scythe – which draws inspiration from the collaborative, crew-oriented ethos of his early days with Raider Klan – alongside the reveal of a full-length group LP to drop in March.

item.title: sim0ne plays with speed and self-image on rave-charged single “freaky﻿”
item.description: A high-octane dance cut, sim0ne's latest single pushes her distinctive blend of trance-edge sonics and rave-ready energy to thrilling new heights.

item.title: RAYE reveals concept album THIS MUSIC MAY CONTAIN HOPE for March release
item.description: RAYE has confirmed details of her follow-up to My 21st Century Blues, with a new LP titled THIS MUSIC MAY CONTAIN HOPE set for release on 27 March and structured across four distinct “seasons”.

item.title: James Blake announces new album Trying Times, featuring Dave and Monica Martin
item.description: James Blake has announced details of his seventh studio album, Trying Times for a 13 March release, and featuring collaborations with rapper Dave and singer Monica Martin.

item.title: Barry Can't Swim announces Late Night Tales compilation
item.description: Barry Can't Swim has shared the details of his upcoming Late Night Tales compilation, and unveiled new single "Chala (My Soul Is On A Loop)".

item.title: Grace Inspace unveils new single, "Helium Balloon"
item.description: LA-born, London-raised artist Grace Inspace has shared her new single, "Helium Balloon", from her upcoming EP Heavy Hair.
